name: s3Exists
description: Tests whether an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket, or a specific object within a bucket, exists.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to test.

params.name: object
params.description: The object key to test. When omitted, the bucket itself is tested.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Check whether an object exists
examples.description: Returns true if the key is present in the bucket.

examples.title: Check whether a bucket exists
examples.description: Without an object argument, tests the bucket itself.
